bindings.name: luaL_sandboxthread
bindings.evidence: Exact eight-operation upstream sandboxthread sequence, including __index string and GLOBALSINDEX -10002. Calls create-table twice, pushvalue, setfield, setreadonly, setmetatable, replace, then tail-calls setsafeenv.

bindings.name: lua_createtable
bindings.evidence: Called twice from sandboxthread with array/hash sizes 0. Its body checks GC/thread barrier, calls table allocator with both size arguments, pushes table tag 7, increments stack.

bindings.name: lua_pushvalue
bindings.evidence: sandboxthread passes GLOBALSINDEX -10002. Body resolves index, copies one 16-byte TValue to top, increments stack.

bindings.name: lua_setfield
bindings.evidence: sandboxthread calls with index -2 and __index. Body resolves index, interns NUL-terminated key, calls table-set using top-1 as value, decrements stack.

bindings.name: lua_setreadonly
bindings.evidence: sandboxthread calls index -1 enabled=1. Body resolves table index and writes boolean readonly field or delegates to current engine readonly helper.

bindings.name: lua_setsafeenv
bindings.evidence: sandboxthread final tail-call passes GLOBALSINDEX -10002 and enabled=1. Body resolves table index and writes normalized safeenv flag.

bindings.name: lua_pushcclosurek
bindings.first_32_bytes: f8 5f bc a9 f6 57 01 a9 f4 4f 02 a9 fd 7b 03 a9 fd c3 00 91 f6 03 04 aa f4 03 03 aa f5 03 02 aa
bindings.inferred_c_abi: void(lua_State*, int(*)(lua_State*), const char*, int, int(*)(lua_State*, int))
bindings.evidence: Saves all five ABI arguments. Allocates C closure with nup/current environment; stores continuation and callback; interns optional debugname; consumes/copies upvalues; pushes function tag 8.

bindings.name: lua_pushlstring
bindings.evidence: Body passes explicit pointer/length to same string intern function used by loader, pushes string tag 6, increments stack. Adjacent lua_pushstring wrapper computes strlen before this call.

bindings.name: lua_tolstring
bindings.evidence: Resolves index, tests string tag 6, otherwise invokes conversion and GC/re-resolves index. On failure writes zero length and returns null; success writes size_t length and returns string data.

bindings.name: lua_gettop
bindings.evidence: Entire 20-byte function loads top and base, subtracts, shifts right by 4, returns. Offsets observed inside engine only; no external struct access required.

bindings.name: lua_settop
bindings.evidence: Positive branch grows stack and fills new slots with nil; negative branch computes top + (idx+1)*16. Used for pop by nearby library registration.

bindings.name: lua_getfield
bindings.evidence: Saves string key/index/state, interns key into a local string TValue, calls table-get to top, increments stack, returns result type. The next entry is rawgetfield with raw table lookup.

bindings.name: lua_pushnil
bindings.evidence: Checks available stack, writes nil tag 0, advances top by 16. Source-order adjacency before pushnumber supports identity.

bindings.name: lua_type
bindings.evidence: Resolves index and returns tag; invalid index returns -1. Adjacent lua_typename references current type-name table, giving independent tag evidence.

bindings.name: luau_load
bindings.inferred_c_abi: int(lua_State*, const char*, const char*, size_t, int)
bindings.evidence: Five entry arguments form LoadContext; pauses GC; passes loadsafe 0x1030ad008 as protected callback; translates OOM into loader error and returns context result. loadsafe uniquely references bytecode mismatch diagnostic.

bindings.name: lua_getreadonly
bindings.evidence: Exact table-index resolution shared with adjacent setreadonly and setsafeenv. Resolves the table pointer, then returns readonly byte7, or tail-calls current engine readonly-page helper0x1030a97d0 when its feature flag is active. Immediately follows verified lua_setreadonly and precedes verified lua_setsafeenv.

bindings.name: lua_checkstack
bindings.evidence: Checks requested size and total top-base slots against8000; size<=0 succeeds. If capacity is insufficient, invokes a protected stack-grow callback0x1030879a4 through verified rawrunprotected0x103098258, returns0 on failure, then expands current call-frame limit to top+size and returns1. This is the engine function that existing push APIs call for extra capacity.

bindings.name: lua_pushboolean
bindings.evidence: Preserves boolean argument in x1, normalizes nonzero to 1, writes boolean tag 1, advances top by one TValue; capacity failure uses lua_checkstack.

bindings.name: lua_pushnumber
bindings.evidence: Preserves double argument from d0, writes it with number tag 3, advances top by one TValue; capacity failure uses lua_checkstack.

bindings.name: lua_tonumberx
bindings.evidence: Resolves index; accepts number tag 3 directly or helper 0x1030ae8c4; returns double in d0 and writes optional isnum int. The helper accepts tag 3 or numeric strings tag 6; rejects integer tag 4.

bindings.name: lua_toboolean
bindings.evidence: Resolves index; nil tag 0 is false, boolean tag 1 reads payload != 0, every other tag is true.

bindings.name: lua_rawgeti
bindings.evidence: Resolves table index and calls numeric table lookup 0x1030a7b50 with signed int key; helper uses w1 and scvtf d0,w1. Pushes one TValue without metamethod lookup and returns its type tag.

bindings.name: lua_ref
bindings.evidence: Resolves input index; nil returns ref 0. Uses engine reference table at global+0x41b0 and free-list/next-ref counters; copies TValue and performs GC barrier. No write to L top: input is NOT popped. Retrieve with paired lua_getref, not an assumed SDK macro.

bindings.name: lua_unref
bindings.evidence: Positive ref writes prior free-list number into the same engine reference table at global+0x41b0 and updates free-list counter, permitting ref reuse. Every path explicitly returns w0=-1. Return is ignored; old SDK void prototype must not be treated as proof of this engine ABI.

bindings.name: lua_getref
bindings.evidence: Adjacent to ref/unref. Reads their same engine reference table at global+0x41b0, calls numeric lookup with ref, pushes one TValue and returns type tag. This is a semantic label for the stripped engine function; do not assume rawgeti(REGISTRYINDEX,ref) is equivalent.

bindings.name: lua_pcall
bindings.evidence: Saves nargs/nresults/errfunc; function stack offset is top-(nargs+1). Passes f_call 0x10308ae8c, CallS, saved stack offset and error-handler offset to protected-call helper 0x103099308; handles MULTRET -1; returns status in w0.

bindings.name: lua_mainthread
bindings.evidence: Exact three-instruction function loads the VM global pointer then the same VM mainthread pointer and returns it. Adjacent API order matches mainthread then absindex/gettop; opaque state identity only, never dereference it in mod code.

bindings.name: lua_rawequal
bindings.evidence: Resolves two indices, returns false for invalid nilobject, then tail-calls raw comparator 0x1030a2090. Comparator checks matching tags and raw payloads/pointers; no equality metamethod or Lua call.

bindings.name: lua_gettable
bindings.evidence: Resolves table/object index, passes current top-1 as both key and output to luaV_gettable 0x1030ae9e4, and returns resulting tag. Replaces key on stack; metamethods can run, so userdata lookup belongs inside a protected C closure.

bindings.name: lua_rawseti
bindings.evidence: Resolves index, saves integer key from x2, checks table readonly byte, calls already verified numeric table setter 0x1030a8f5c with that key, copies top-1 value into table slot, performs GC barrier, decrements top by one TValue. Adjacent rawset variant consumes key+value; upstream API order and exact setter semantics match lua_rawseti.

luau_load_environment_semantics.env_argument: w4, fifth ABI argument; preserved at LoadContext+0x48
luau_load_environment_semantics.env_zero: Reads current global table L->gt through engine code. Bind injector target to GLOBALSINDEX -10002.
luau_load_environment_semantics.env_nonzero: At0x1030ad164–0x1030ad17c invokes luaA_toobject(L,env)0x103087778 and reads table value. env is an existing stack or pseudo-index, not a state pointer.
luau_load_environment_semantics.negative_index_handling: Before any stack pushes, normalize ordinary negative indices -10000<env<0 to beforeTop+env+1. Keep pseudo-indices <=-10000 unchanged.
luau_load_environment_semantics.stack_contract: Restore original top before invoking original loader; leave original env argument unchanged. Verify target type table7; skip read-only targets unless a separately approved unfreeze/restore path is implemented.
luau_load_environment_semantics.checkstack: Call lua_checkstack(L,8) before reserving extra local stack slots; zero return means defer/skip injection.

workspace_api_constants.lua_upvalueindex_formula: LUA_GLOBALSINDEX - i, with i >= 1 and an actual C closure holding at least i upvalues
workspace_api_constants.evidence: Pseudo-index helper compares -10002/-10001/-10000 explicitly. Its closure-upvalue path computes first upvalue from -10003 and bounds it against nup. Existing engine type-name evidence confirms tags; ref/unref disassembly confirms ref sentinel behavior.

workspace_reference_semantics.reference_table: Engine lua_ref/lua_unref/lua_getref consistently use the same private reference-table pointer; no mod reads or writes its structures.
workspace_reference_semantics.retrieval: Use verified lua_getref(L,ref). LUA_REGISTRYINDEX resolves a different field location; equality with the private reference table is unproved. Never substitute the old SDK lua_getref macro.
workspace_reference_semantics.stack: lua_ref(L,index) leaves the value on stack; lua_getref pushes one value and returns its tag; lua_unref changes no stack entries and returns -1.
workspace_reference_semantics.reuse: lua_unref permits ref IDs to be reused. Tombstone/remove listener records before unref; callback snapshots must verify records are still connected and generation matches.
workspace_reference_semantics.identity: Record verified lua_mainthread(currentL) for every owner/ref. Retrieve or unref only from a currently executing engine state whose mainthread matches. Do not save a lua_State pointer as an independently runnable callback state.
workspace_reference_semantics.lifecycle: Mainthread pointer identity is valid only while that VM lives and is not a permanent generation identifier. Remove owner refs during Plugin.Unloading while a live matching state exists; disconnect/free per-VM pump when no owners remain. Clear all stale records on VM lifecycle boundaries to avoid address reuse.
workspace_reference_semantics.scheduler: Deliver through an ordinary engine signal such as RunService.Heartbeat. Native Qt/UI code may queue plain data only; it must not invoke Lua on a GUI/background thread.
workspace_reference_semantics.protected_delivery: Check stack capacity before temporary pushes; preserve top; retrieve listener using lua_getref; verify function tag 8; push arguments; lua_pcall with an explicit result count and errfunc=0; copy string error before restoring original top. Lookup/set operations with possible metamethods must be inside a protected native closure too.
workspace_reference_semantics.yielding: Do not promise yielding listeners. This plain lua_pcall path and C closure without a verified continuation/scheduling contract must treat callback yield attempts as errors.
workspace_reference_semantics.permission_context: Same-VM identity does not prove Roblox execution permission identity. A Heartbeat-driven native callback runs in the engine-provided signal context; plugin method access from callbacks, especially across owners, requires a live test and must not claim transparent owner-context preservation.

workspace_number_semantics.push: lua_pushnumber receives double in d0 and creates tag 3.
workspace_number_semantics.read: lua_tonumberx reads tag 3 and numeric strings; it rejects separate integer tag 4. Require tag 3 for initial numeric workspace settings; reject integer tag 4 until a separate integer API is verified.
